capability_claim: A fixed technical design first tests fit-for-purpose existing/runtime/platform/dependency mechanisms and explicitly classifies shared/foundation impact with minimum runway and walking-skeleton proof without selecting by line/file count.

input.prompt: Design a fixed technical decision where the supported platform already provides the exact required primitive and current canonical callers can use it.

invariants.criterion: Evaluate and select the sufficient existing/platform mechanism before inventing custom alternatives.

forbidden_behaviors: Fabricate a custom option merely to satisfy a minimum alternatives count.

input.prompt: Design an approved shared frontend token/component seam required by three current screens.

invariants.criterion: Classify SHARED/FOUNDATION from current consumers, define the minimum runway, blockers and one representative walking-skeleton proof.

forbidden_behaviors: Design a full future design system beyond current consumers.

input.prompt: Design a local internal module change with one current caller and no shared contract impact.

invariants.criterion: Keep impact CONTAINED when source evidence does not justify shared/foundation work.
